spans.s: osopati (= Skt. *ava-svapiti; see s.v. avasvāpayati; cf. sopita, and next), sleeps, is asleep (ppp. osupta): Mv 〔ii.31.21〕 (āgamehi muhūrtaṃ, kumāro saṃprati) osupto. ṛṣi āha: mahārāja na kumāro osopati; 〔ii.159.4〕 (bodhisattvo) pratibuddho paśyati antaḥpuram osuptam.
osopana, nt. (to prec.; cf. AMg. osovaṇī, profound sleep acc. to Ratnach.), sleep, or putting to sleep: Mv 〔ii.160.6〕 devehi sarvasya janasya … osopanaṃ kṛtaṃ. Cf. also osvāpana, apasvāpana.
